heading: Route and Permission Control
content: Use Hyper Tern concepts to define who can invoke an AI workflow, which model route it may use, what tools it may reach, and where human review remains required.

heading: Privacy-Aware Inference
content: Use Hyper-ABS concepts to reduce unnecessary raw-data exposure before inference through data classification, context minimization, and documented workflow boundaries.

heading: Verifiable Execution Records
content: Use Hyper-0x to preserve attributable records of configured AI actions so reviewers can inspect what was requested, allowed, executed, and escalated.

heading: Custom AI Support
content: Plan custom model and fine-tuning work around data boundaries, evaluation expectations, deployment controls, and realistic operating limits.
